mapper.select: SELECT article_id, user_id, emoji, create_time, deleted_at FROM article_reactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND article_id IN #{articleId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_reactions(article_id, user_id, emoji, create_time, deleted_at) VALUES (#{articleId}, #{userId}, #{emoji}, #{createTime}, NULL) ON CONFLICT (article_id, user_id, emoji) DO UPDATE SET create_time = EXCLUDED.create_time, deleted_at = NULL
